Skytruth Analysis

AT 8:30 AM, A TRUCK WAS DELIVERING A LOAD OF SLAG TO SABIN METAL CORPORATION WHEN A HYDRAULIC LINE BURST. APPROXIMATELY 20 GALLONS OF HYDRAULIC OIL WAS SPRAYED ONTO AN AREA OF ABOUT 30 FEET BY 40 FEET. THAT AREA WAS MOSTLY GRAVEL ABOUT 1" TO 1 1/2" DEEP, WITH SOME BARE SOIL BEING AFFECTED. THIS AREA HAS NO IMMEDIATE CONVEYANCE TO A BODY OF WATER. THE CLEAN-UP PLAN IS TO SCRAPE UP ALL OF THE GRAVEL AND ABOUT 1" OF UNDERLYING SOIL, CONTAINERIZE IT AND BURN IT IN A THERMAL UNIT PERMITTED FOR BURNING PLANT GENERATED WASTE. THE NEW YORK STATE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL CONSERVATION HAS BEEN NOTIFIED AND THE STATE REPORT NUMBER IS 1102297.

Report Description
REPORT RECEIVED FROM NOAA EMAIL: AN AREA OF POSSIBLE OIL EXTENDS TO THE SOUTHWEST OF THE DESTROYED TAYLOR PLATFORM THIS AFTERNOON. ATMOSPHERIC CONDITIONS SHOW MOSTLY CLEAR SKIES OVER THE POINT SOURCE WITH LIGHT SURFACE WINDS OUT OF THE EAST/SOUTHEAST. OCEAN CURRENTS ARE CURRENTLY OUT OF THE EAST/NORTHEAST. AQUA MODIS IMAGE TAKEN ALMOST 2 HOURS LATER SHOWS THE SAME AREA OF OIL WHICH ENHANCES THE CONFIDENCE OF THIS ANALYSIS. UNCERTAINTIES: CONFIDENCE IS FAIRLY HIGH WITH THIS AREA OF POSSIBLE OIL DUE TO THE DIRECTION OF THE OCEAN CURRENTS AS WELL AS THE SAME PRESENCE OF POSSIBLE OIL BEING SEEN IN THE MODIS AQUA IMAGE. THERE IS SOME UNCERTAINTY DUE TO THE DIRECTION OF THE SURFACE WINDS BEING OUT OF THE EAST/SOUTHEAST BUT DUE TO THEIR LIGHT TO CALM SPEED, THIS MAY NOT BE A FACTOR IN DETERMINING WHERE THE OIL WILL EXTEND FROM THE LEAK SITE.

properties.title: NRC Report: Isopar  Cas Code 64742-42-8 in Sub Surface near New Orleans, LA
properties.summary: Incident Type: VESSEL - NRC Report ID: 879250 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: WESTERN GECO
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 879250
Incident Time: 2008-07-31 22:58:00
Nearest City: New Orleans, LA
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: ISOPAR CAS CODE 64742-42-8
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: WESTERN GECO
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 19.81 gallons
FULL DESCRIPTION : SEISMIC CABLE 1 PARTED JUST BEHIND ICU . REASON FOR THE BREAK IS UNKNOWN. POSSIBLE HIT SOME FLOATING OBJECT DRIFTING IN THE SEA THE VESSEL WAS IN THE PROCESS OF STACKING ACROSS TO WING 1 TO EFFECT REPAIRS AT THE FRONT END OF CABLE 1 . CABLE 1 HAD BEEN DEAD FOR A FEW DAYS ( FIBER PROBLEM AROUND THE MINIWING, CONFIRMED EARLIER BY WORK BOAT) ) AND AS WE WERE IN THE PROCESS OF DOING MONOWING MAINTENANCE THE CLIENT DECIDED THAT WE SHOULD REPAIR CABLE 1 AT THIS TIME. AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT THE STARBOARD SIDE HAD BEEN RECOVERED IN ORDER TO DISCONNECT THE DISTANCE ROPE FROM 5, AND STACK THIS BEHIND THE VESSEL. CABLE 1 HAD THE QFINS IN BACKUP COMMS AND THE DIGIBIRDS WERE ALL WORKING. FROM THE NAVIGATION REPLY IT COULD BE SEEN THAT THIS CABLE WAS WELL CLEAR OF THE OTHER CABLES. THERE WERE NO OTHER INDICATORS AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT , THE TENSION CELL ON THIS CABLE WAS NOT FUNCTIONING SO NO CHANGES IN TENSION CAN BE CONFIRMED. THE PARTED CABLE DRIFTED FREE AND CAME TO REST ACROSS TAILBUOYS 2, 3, 4 . VESSEL SPEED WAS SLOWED TO MINIMUM AT THIS POINT , WING ANGLE IN WING 1 DECREASED AND THE SPREAD STABILIZED. THE ENTIRE SPREAD WAS TOWED IN THIS MANNER OVERNIGHT WHILE CABLE 5 WAS RECOVERED . UPDATE 1ST AUG THE WORK BOATS WERE LAUNCHED AT FIRST LIGHT TO INVESTIGATE. THE TWO WORK BOATS WORKED IN TANDEM TO SUCCESSFULLY RELEASE ALL OF THE CABLE FROM 2,3,4 PASSING IT TO 4 WINDS , ODYSSEY AND THE DAMAGED PART TO THE SNAPPER . ESTIMATES AT THIS TIME ARE 11 ACTIVE SECTIONS DAMAGED , 1 SCRAP AND 75 LTRS OF KERO ( 3/4 OF ONE SECTION) RELEASED INTO THE SEA.

Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: CHEVRON ORONITE COMPANY
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 0.5 feet by 0.5 feet (area 0.25 sq. ft.)
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
WHILE WALKING ALONG THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER’S BANK (ALONG THE REVETMENT) ON DECEMBER 22, 2010, SMALL SHEEN CIRCLES WERE OBSERVED ON THE WATER. UPON INSPECTION, IT WAS DETERMINED THE SOURCE MAY BE AN INTERMITTENT SEEP OF LIGHT NON AQUEOUS PHASE LIQUID (LNAPL) GLOBULES RESULTING FROM HISTORIC OPERATIONS AT THE FACILITY. THE SHEEN DISSIPATED QUICKLY AFTER FIRST APPEARING ON THE WATER. A SIMILAR INCIDENT OCCURRED ON NOVEMBER 10, 2010, AND WAS REPORTED TO THE NRC UNDER INCIDENT REPORT # 959615 AND LDEQ SPOC SYSTEM INCIDENT REPORT # GT01 8451. THIS AREA IS CURRENTLY BEING INVESTIGATED UNDER THE DIRECTION OF THE LDEQ (AI NO. 1708) WITH FERNANDO ITURRALDE OF LDEQ.

JOHNS RIVER.

THERE WAS A MERCURY SPILL AT THE SITE RESIDENCE. APPEARS VANDALS SMASHED UP TO 20 MERCURY CONTAINING THERMOMETERS AT THE HOME .THE PROPERTY IS A RESIDENTIAL SINGLE-FAMILY BANK-OWNED HOME. THE SPILL WAS DISCOVERED BY A REAL-ESTATE AGENT THAT ARRIVED ONSITE , THE AGENT NOTICED THE MERCURY SPILL AND CALLED 911. THE AGENTS SHOES AND VEHICLE FLOOR MATS ARE BAGGED ON SITE . THE INTERIOR OF THE HOUSE MAY BE IMPACTED AND THIS WILL NEED TO BE ASSESSED BY THE OWNER (BANK) AFTER OUTDOOR WORK IS COMPLETE. EL MIRAGE FIRE DEPARTMENT HAZMAT TEAM ARRIVED ONSITE AND WILL BE FUNDING THE INITIAL CLEAN UP AS IT IS A PUBLIC HEALTH ISSUE. (THE BANK WILL LIKELY BE HELD FINANCIALLY RESPONSIBLE FOR THE CLEAN UP ). HAZMAT TEAM (KARY ENVIRONMENTAL) IS ON SITE. THE MERCURY CONTAMINATION HAS BEEN REPORTED TO COVER A ROUGHLY 20’ X 20’ AREA IN THE FRONT YARD (THE AREA INCLUDES THE WALKWAY, YARD, AND BRICK PORCH AREA ). CREW IS ONSITE CURRENTLY SECURING THE AREA WITH PERSONNEL AND WILL NOT LEAVE UNTIL THE AREA IS SECURED WITH TEMPORARY FENCING . THE 3RD PARTY ENVIRONMENTAL CONSULTANT WILL BE ON SITE TOMORROW MORNING WITH MERCURY VAPOR ANALYZERS TO BETTER DEFINE THE AREA OF IMPACT AND TO WRITE A SCOPE OF REMEDIATION. REMEDIATION IS SLATED TO BEGIN FRIDAY AND WILL CONTINUE MONDAY, TUESDAY AND WEDNESDAY OF NEXT WEEK AS NEEDED.

THE MERCURY CONTAMINATION HAS BEEN REPORTED TO COVER A ROUGHLY 20’ X 20’ AREA IN THE FRONT YARD (THE AREA INCLUDES THE WALKWAY, YARD, AND BRICK PORCH AREA ). CREW IS ONSITE CURRENTLY SECURING THE AREA WITH PERSONNEL AND WILL NOT LEAVE UNTIL THE AREA IS SECURED WITH TEMPORARY FENCING . THE 3RD PARTY ENVIRONMENTAL CONSULTANT WILL BE ON SITE TOMORROW MORNING WITH MERCURY VAPOR ANALYZERS TO BETTER DEFINE THE AREA OF IMPACT AND TO WRITE A SCOPE OF REMEDIATION. REMEDIATION IS SLATED TO BEGIN FRIDAY AND WILL CONTINUE MONDAY, TUESDAY AND WEDNESDAY OF NEXT WEEK AS NEEDED.
